text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road safely makes her debut. 
True to her earnest nature, she 
immediately holds a review session with 
her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around that time, blood dripped from her 
leg... She had been in such deep 
concentration that she hadn't noticed the 
injury. At first glance, that might seem 
like a strength, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, she didn't even notice she had 
sustained minor injuries even during 
practice. ...Seeing her push herself that 
hard brought a sense of alarm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"For now, they suggest gaining race 
experience without setting specific goals. 
Acting as her brakes to keep her safe, 
their three-legged race begins."
